cohort: Babies born to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus at a single hospital in India between November 1, 2014, and October 31, 2015.
finding: Babies born to mothers with GDM who had optimal blood sugar control had better outcomes, with most having normal birth weights, favorable APGAR scores, and low rates of complications like hypoglycemia and congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: The most common mode of delivery was vaginal (58.1%), followed by lower segment cesarean section (41.9%), with previous cesarean section (12.2%) and failed induction (9.5%) as the most common indications for cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: A substantial number of babies had birth weights within the normal range.
